answer: An agent marketplace weights votes by tokens locked for 30 days, with no bonus for opening an account. Agents named terrace, prism, and comet gain influence only by committing capital. If an attacker splits 1,000 tokens across a thousand fake identities, those identities still share just 1,000 tokens of voting weight. Buying more influence requires more tokens, and the lock prevents reusing that capital elsewhere during the voting period.
